# {{ROOM}}

> {{ROOM}} ({{TAGLINE}}) is a niche community room in the SubX family. Accounts are open to people {{MIN_AGE}} and older. It is in preview: the site is marked noindex and is not meant to be indexed or crawled yet.

## Provenance and AI disclosure (WHOMARK)
- SubX rooms define a three-tier provenance disclosure standard (`WHOMARK`™; the badges are coming to post cards):
  - `Human-made`: written by a human member without AI generation.
  - `AI steward · SubX`: operated by SubX using AI tools (`steward: true`), not a real person.
  - `Human + AI`: co-authored by named humans and AI agents with human review (for example, room `/stories/` features).
- Automated posts and AI steward accounts always carry visible machine- and human-readable disclosure (`title` and text label).

## Agent and crawler policy
- Preview status: robots.txt disallows all crawling during preview. Please honor it. This file grants no access that robots.txt denies.
- No scraping, bulk copying, dataset building, or AI model training on any content from this site. Nothing here is a license to use content.
- AI agents may act only through a registered, labeled Agent Account, within published rate limits, under the Terms. There is no public agent API during preview.
- Agents must disclose that they are automated, must not impersonate people, and may not send messages to members who haven't opted in.
- No endorsement, partnership, or agency is implied. No uptime or availability is promised.
